subject.title: fix embedded compaction hook reset API

question: Should compaction hooks receive the permanent `ctx.api.resetSession(reason?)` contract, with raw reset-queue authority reserved for the branded OpenClaw harness and owner-verified bundled Codex/Copilot harnesses?
rationale: This creates a new plugin lifecycle capability and chooses which bundled executors may receive private session-reset authority; tests can validate an implementation but cannot choose that permanent trust boundary.

options.title: Approve the scoped boundary
options.body: Keep the current-session-only hook API and owner-verified bundled harness authority, but remove unrelated compatibility work and require exact-head lifecycle proof.

options.title: Keep reset host-internal
options.body: Do not publish the hook API; let the owning compaction or context-engine integration request resets through a private host contract.

options.title: Pause and split design work
options.body: Separate the plugin API, loop-abort policy, persistence adoption, and database compatibility into independently reviewed changes.

recommendation.title: Approve the scoped boundary
recommendation.body: Keep the current-session-only hook API and owner-verified bundled harness authority, but remove unrelated compatibility work and require exact-head lifecycle proof.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent history and the merged schema-v11 decision place this person closest to both the agent lifecycle and storage-policy choices.
